steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each closed deal is placed by its reason code and whether the code is on the list.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 closed deal has no reason code

findings.title: Closed deal with no reason code
findings.fix: Record the reason the deal closed the way it did

findings.title: Reason not in the code list
findings.fix: Map the reason to the list

findings.title: One reason accounts for over half of losses with no note

outcome.notChecked: The true reason; deals not coded.
